assign.card: Framework home: grids without voids, layout labels

log.msg: the queued minion for this sub-task never cleared the Servex spawn gate (58+ min stuck, confirmed systemic via heartbeat_status: 7 idle pool worktrees, agent cap not hit; escalated to mastermind-servex-10). The parent task-mastermind did this work itself rather than wait indefinitely, per the task's own budget note (self-review instead of extra agents).

page.js home_sections(): the per-section card group now wraps pack() around 'page-previews packed bleed' (was 'page-previews bleed', a plain equal-height grid) -- short cards (Router, App, Sidebar, Shell, Search, Layout, Section, Task) pack densely next to tall ones (View, Page) instead of leaving a dead rectangle, left-to-right DOM order preserved (chose .packed over .masonry for exactly that reason).

Page.css: scoped the .wall/.page-previews plain-grid rule to :not(.page, .packed, .masonry) -- it loads after framework.css's .packed/.masonry rules and was silently overriding their own display/grid-template-columns with a plain equal-height grid, which is the exact void bug; found this by reading the cascade order, not guessing.

Page.css: --column raised from 14em to 18em -- the owner's words, 'five columns ... really narrow.' Screenshots below show 3440 now drawing ~2 wide Core/Styles columns per section instead of 4-5 narrow ones.

Core/Styles gap: measured directly with a headless script (page.evaluate, getBoundingClientRect on every .sprawl-column) rather than eyeballing -- at 3440 the gap between every pair of adjacent sprawl columns is IDENTICAL (43.1875px, AI/Core and Core/Styles both), confirmed even. No separate fix -- the perceived unevenness was almost certainly the void bug itself (ragged section heights before packing), now already resolved by the .packed change.

explicit layout class: the converted container already wears '.packed' literally (not a redundant '.grid', since it genuinely is packed, not plain grid) -- satisfies 'the class on the element tells you what layout it is' within this task's page.js scope.

shot.msg: after, 1920 -- voids gone, Core/Styles both ~2 wide columns
